root_cause: Escape keydown event on the dropdown toggle calls event.stopPropagation(), preventing the event from reaching the modal's keyboard dismiss listener.
repair_strategy: Remove event.stopPropagation() call for Escape key in dropdown.js dataApiKeydownHandler, keeping event.preventDefault() to allow the event to bubble to the modal while still preventing default browser action.
expected_accessibility_effect: Escape key will now close the share dialog when focus is on the access toggle button, satisfying the requirement that Escape closes the dialog.
functional_risks: Potential side effects if other components rely on Escape being stopped by dropdown; however modal's keyboard dismiss is appropriate and unlikely to cause conflicts.
verification_requirements: Press Escape on the access toggle button to verify the modal closes (button becomes invisible).
Verify that Escape still closes an open dropdown menu when focus is inside the menu.
Ensure ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Space, and Enter keys still work for dropdown navigation and selection.
